newEntry.name: Comb & Curl
newEntry.desc: Snip twelve runners and seat a blunt-tined spine in two calibrated feet for a standing paper-quilling comb kit. Adjust tine pitch, count, height and foot silhouettes; measured sheet/socket reference, local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL badges, connected-card and clean-part STL/ZIP. Paper and adhesive required; physical strength and release untested.
